issues.explanation: Login and Register validate via inline $this->validate([...]) without #[Validate] attributes or rules() method required by the project pattern.
Password reset update validates three fields inline instead of a Form Request once rules grow beyond one or two fields.

Guest middleware on Livewire login/register routes is not persisted via Livewire::addPersistentMiddleware, so an authenticated user could invoke submit through the update endpoint bypassing the guest redirect.
No unauthorized-call test for Livewire submit actions (authenticated user invoking Login or Register submit).
No CHANGELOG, docs, or PHPDoc updates accompany the new public actions despite the docs-in-sync convention.

conventions.evidence: Follows route() in all new views, named-route redirects, plain wire:model, Bulma classes and shared x-layouts.app; deviates: Login.php:194 and Register.php:280 use $this->validate([...]) with no #[Validate] attributes vs required #[Validate]+validate; PasswordResetController.php:138 3-field inline validate without Form Request; no CHANGELOG/docs update.

readability.evidence: Small focused methods (submit/render/ensureIsNotRateLimited/throttleKey), clear names, consistent Blade with {{ }} escaping, layouts delegate (resources/views/layouts/app.blade.php:1-4), no dead code or debug output.

requirements.evidence: Login strict email + auth.failed on email + throttle per lower email+IP + regenerate + redirectIntended home (app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:194-212,238-241); Register strict/unique/confirmed + Password::default + key str()->transliterate('register|'.ip) + Registered + login + regenerate (Register.php:280-297,323-326); logout invalidate+regenerateToken+route login; home auth+verified; forgot always status + throttle:6,1; reset single name="email" + remember_token rotation + PasswordReset + route login; EmailVerificationRequest 403 + redirect home + resend guard; .env pt_BR + phpunit pins + lang/en|pt_BR/ui.php with Entrar/Senha/Esqueceu vs Log in.

scope.evidence: Every hunk serves auth/localization contract: controllers, Livewire, views, routes, User MustVerifyEmail, Password::defaults, .env/phpunit locale pins, ui lang files, AuthFlowTest; no unrelated refactors or features.

security.evidence: Strict server-side validation, {{ }} escaping, Fillable kept, session regenerate/invalidate + token regeneration, remember_token rotation, signed+throttle:6,1 verify via EmailVerificationRequest, RateLimiter on login/register, CSRF tokens; only gap is non-persisted guest middleware for Livewire updates (limited impact).

simplicity.evidence: Reuses Password::defaults (AppServiceProvider.php:368), Password broker, EmailVerificationRequest::fulfill, RateLimiter, Str::transliterate keys, shared x-layouts.app; minimum code, no service layers or duplication.

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/Auth/AuthFlowTest.php covers pt_BR locale, localized login, login success/fail/rate-limit/auth-redirect, register create/validation/rate-limit, logout, home auth+verified, forgot never-reveals+429, reset single-email/rotation/reject, verification 403/tamper/resend, hardcoded-path scan; missing only Livewire unauthorized-submit test.

review.summary: Implements the full session auth flow, verification, password reset, pt_BR localization and route/view contract with strong Pest coverage. Conventions deviations (no #[Validate] attributes, no Form Request, no docs) and non-persisted guest middleware for Livewire updates keep it at approve-with-nits.
